status: expectations drafted 2026-09-14 from the corpus text, reviewed and confirmed by the author 2026-10-03 (amendment 1 in METHOD.md); the live recording has not been made yet

cases.question: Qual é o objetivo da avaliação interna de risco prevista na Circular 3.978?
cases.why: Art. 10 states it: identify and measure the risk of the institution's products and services being used for ML/TF.

cases.question: Em que prazo a comunicação de operação suspeita deve ser feita ao Coaf?
cases.why: Art. 48, § 2º: until the business day following the decision to communicate.

cases.question: Depósitos em espécie atípicos em relação à atividade econômica do cliente são indício de suspeita segundo a Carta Circular 4.001?
cases.why: Art. 1º, I, a) of Carta Circular 4.001 lists exactly that; the unit is art. 1º, caput (its incisos and alíneas nest under it).

cases.question: Quando a Circular 3.978 entra em vigor?
cases.why: The demonstration case. Consolidated art. 70 says 1º/10/2020 (Circular 4.005); the original said 1º/7/2020 and may be mentioned as history, never alone.

cases.question: A identificação de cliente pessoa jurídica exige o endereço da sede?
cases.why: Consolidated art. 16, § 2º, II (Resolução BCB 119/2021) requires firma/denominação and CNPJ only; the original required the address, so an answer drawn from the original says yes where the text in force says no. The question has no binary answer, which this expectation got wrong at first by demanding the word 'não': art. 16, § 4º, unchanged by the amendment, does require o endereço da sede for a legal person seated abroad and exempt from CNPJ. Whether an answer that opens with 'Sim' and then gives both rules is right is a judgement about content, which is the author's to make in the grade, not a phrase for the form check.

cases.question: O que o texto original da Circular 3.978 previa como data de entrada em vigor?
cases.why: Legitimately about the original; the contract still requires the version in force to be cited alongside.

cases.question: Quais procedimentos devem ser adotados na compra de ouro?
cases.why: The corpus has red-flag situations around the gold market (4.001, art. 1º, XIX, under the art. 1º unit); purchase procedures are in IN BCB 406/2023, outside the corpus. The showcase of the third outcome. The expectation first demanded that the declared gap name '406', which asked the model to know the number of an act the corpus does not contain — outside knowledge, the one thing the contract forbids. A partial must declare a gap, which the Draft model enforces; whether the gap is the right one is graded by hand.

cases.question: Qual o prazo para uma joalheria comunicar operações suspeitas ao Coaf?
cases.why: The dangerous error here is not inventing, it is transplanting: the corpus does set a deadline for reporting suspicious operations to the Coaf (art. 48, § 2º: the next business day), but for institutions authorised by the BCB. Jewellers are supervised by the Coaf itself and are nowhere in this corpus. The honest response states the deadline the corpus sets, says whom it binds, and declares that this sector is not covered — which is what partial is for. Answering with the number alone is the failure; refusing outright throws away what the corpus does say.

cases.question: O que a Resolução BCB 344 mudou na Circular 3.978?
cases.why: Answerable, and it was not before amendment 2 of the retrieval set. Resolução 344's art. 1º states its own effect exhaustively — 'passa a vigorar com as seguintes alterações:' followed by the full text it gives to art. 23-A, closing with (NR) — and that transcription is now indexed, joined to the article that transcribes it. The answer names art. 23-A and what it dispenses. It cites the resolution because that is where the corpus says what the resolution did; the wording in force is in Circular 3.978, art. 23-A, and the passage's own header says so.

cases.question: Qual é a pena para o crime de lavagem de dinheiro?
cases.why: Lei 9.613/1998 is federal law, not a BCB act; the corpus regulates institutions, not the crime.

cases.question: Qual é a multa por descumprir a Circular 3.978?
cases.why: Penalties are in Resolução BCB 131/2021, outside the corpus.

cases.question: Qual é o prazo?
cases.why: Prazo for what? The corpus has several; the ambiguity must be named.

cases.question: O que diz o art. 4º?
cases.why: Art. 4º of which act? Both 3.978 and 3.461 have one, on different subjects.

cases.question: O que a Circular 3.461 dizia sobre pessoas expostas politicamente?
cases.why: Answerable from the revoked text, provided the revocation by Circular 3.978 (from 1º/10/2020) is stated and its notice cited — the contract's revoked_without_notice rule.

cases.question: Quais informações cadastrais a Circular 3.461 exige dos clientes?
cases.why: Present tense about a revoked act: the trap is answering as if it were in force. The answer is correct when it gives what art. 2º required and states that the act was revoked, citing the notice — so both are required here; citing only the revocation would pass on form while answering nothing, and answering without it is the silent failure this case exists to catch.
